verdict.rationale: Evidence shows phone-based acknowledgment ('press 1 to acknowledge' via a call), push notifications as an alert channel, and 'single tap' acknowledgment of multiple simultaneous incidents which implies a mobile app exists, plus escalation policies that page in order. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated mobile app supporting escalate and resolve actions (only acknowledge is directly evidenced), and no app-store or hands-on mobile UX confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit mobile app description/screenshots, evidence of resolving and escalating (not just acknowledging) from the phone, and independent corroboration of the mobile experience.
